title: Buena Vista Social Club (bc30)
synopsis: Lauded German filmmaker Wim Wenders follows his longtime musical collaborator, guitarist Ry Cooder, to Havana to bring together a forgotten generation of Cuba's legendary veteran musicians. Weaving intimate studio recordings with poignant portraits of masters like singer Ibrahim Ferrer and pianist Rubén González, the documentary charts their miraculous comeback, leading up to an emotional, historic concert at New York's Carnegie Hall. Released to critical acclaim worldwide, the film even saw Wim Wenders visit bc in 2000 to meet audiences in person.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 長期合作好友 Ry Cooder 剛為一班古巴老樂手監製唱片，向雲溫達斯大力推介，他一聽後驚為天人，帶同攝製隊到古巴記錄這些年屆古稀的音樂人錄音的過程和各人的故事。夏灣拿曾是歐美樂手匯聚的音樂之都，在卡斯特羅政權統治數十載後卻與世界脫軌，這些樂手更被聽眾遺忘，有些甚至淪為擦鞋匠。唱片推出後，他們揉合古巴傳統與拉丁爵士的音樂風靡全球，最後更在紐約殿堂級表演場地卡內基音樂廳演出。這部紀錄片面世後大受好評，雲溫達斯亦於 2000 年親臨 bc 與影迷交流。
